Bond yields are highly sensitive to market conditions, credit spreads, and interest rate expectations. Over such a short timeframe, yields could move either direction based on daily market sentiment. Without specific information about expected market conditions during this period, this is essentially a coin flip with slight consideration that high-yield spreads tend to be volatile.
